output.normalization: Generated images resampled to exact output dimensions without adding margins or cropping artwork.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE finished raster game card face: January bright card (송학 광) for a Korean Go-Stop / 맞고 deck.
FORMAT: portrait aspect ratio exactly 5:8, ideally 1000 by 1600 pixels. The image IS the card face, rectangular artwork filling EVERY pixel edge to edge. Full bleed. No visible card object, rounded corners, paper, tabletop, mockup, exterior margin, cast shadow, frame or border.
STYLE SYSTEM for a repeatable 48-card deck: modernized CLASSIC KOREAN plastic hwatu. Graphic screen-printed appearance, bold smooth black outlines of consistent thickness, flat highly saturated crimson red, near-black, dark pine green and warm ivory; tiny warm gold accents only if essential. Large iconic simple shapes readable at 60px width. A very subtle glossy plastic sheen across the printed surface, not gradients or a dramatic reflection. NOT a painting or landscape illustration.
JANUARY CONTENT AND COMPOSITION: warm ivory/white field; large solid crimson red circular sun near the top, kept clearly visible. A large elegant WHITE CRANE with black wing/tail accents and a red crown stands on slender black legs in the bottom third, its recognizable long neck rising into the middle. Dark green stylized pine boughs with thick black branching trunks frame the sides and lower area, classic Korean hwatu pine clusters with simple bold needle group shapes. Keep crane and red sun prominent. Use the familiar traditional 송학 layout simplified into confident screen-print shapes, not a naturalistic forest.
ONLY TEXT ALLOWED: a small crimson-red circular seal in the TOP LEFT corner containing exactly the single Hanja character “光” in ivory, legible and correctly drawn. No other text, letters, digits, logos or symbols.
AVOID: Japanese motifs of any kind, torii, shrines, kimono, Japanese text, extra animals, detailed feather texture, sunset scenery, mountains, clouds. No outer card border.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE new August bright Korean Go-Stop hwatu card (공산 광). The provided January card is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its bold black print outlines, warm ivory, rich crimson, simple large graphic silhouettes, restrained plastic sheen and small 光 corner seal. Do not include its crane, pine tree or red sun.
FORMAT: portrait 5:8, 1000x1600 pixels. Artwork fills the entire rectangular image edge-to-edge, full bleed. No exterior space, no card mockup, no border, no frame, no rounded corners, no shadow.
AUGUST COMPOSITION: the TOP HALF is a flat deep saturated crimson-red sky containing ONE HUGE clean warm-white FULL MOON, a complete circular disk, centered slightly right so it avoids the corner seal. Moon should nearly fill the height of this upper half and be instantly recognizable at 60px wide. No moon texture or face. The BOTTOM HALF is one massive BLACK rounded hill, a smooth broad gently domed silhouette rising centrally into the red sky. At the hill's lower edge include a few sparse, simple ivory and black grass-blade marks in the classic Korean 공산 hwatu graphic idiom, with at most a narrow ivory strip at the very bottom. Keep the hill predominantly solid black. No other hills, mountains, plants or scenery.
Style: modernized classic KOREAN plastic hwatu, crisp flat screen-printed color, no painterly detail, no naturalistic landscape, no sunset, no gradients except an almost imperceptible plastic sheen.
ONLY TEXT: in the top-left, a small crimson circular seal with the single warm-ivory Hanja character “光”; use a thin ivory rim so the seal is visible against the red sky, closely matching the January reference.
No other text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, decorative symbols. Absolutely no Japanese motifs, shrines, torii, kimono, Japanese writing.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE new December DOUBLE-JUNK rain card (비 쌍피) for a Korean Go-Stop / 맞고 deck.
INPUT IMAGE ROLE: provided January card is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its heavy smooth black outlines, flat warm ivory, crimson and pine green screen-print palette, large simple graphic shapes and restrained subtle glossy plastic finish. Do not repeat the crane, pine, sun or 光 seal.
FORMAT: portrait exactly 5:8, ideally 1000x1600. The rectangular artwork fills all pixels edge to edge, a finished card-face texture with NO external background, mockup, rounded corners, shadow, margin, card frame or outer border.
CONTENT: a classic stylized Korean December rain hwatu junk motif. Warm ivory field. A bold almost-black STORM CLOUD sweeps across the upper edge. Large parallel BLACK DIAGONAL RAIN STREAKS fall across the background, widely spaced so the image remains simple at 60px width. A hanging WILLOW BRANCH with long drooping dark pine-green narrow leaves enters from the upper-right and runs down one side.
At the CENTER and lower middle, dominant large abstract RED-AND-BLACK ORNAMENTAL DRUM SHAPE from the classic hwatu December junk design: a stylized rounded barrel / hourglass drum, two curved crimson drum rims, a broad warm ivory drum skin and black body with a few simple thick black lacing diagonals. Clearly an abstract ceremonial DRUM shape, not architecture: NO pillars, no posts, no doorway, no roof beam, no gate, no temple. Keep its silhouette compact and curved, graphic and recognizable. A few simplified black rain/water strokes near the bottom, no detailed scenery. Flat saturated colors, no painterly rendering or scene depth.
NO TEXT ANYWHERE, no letters, no Hanja 光, no numbers, no double-value marks, no logos or watermarks. Absolutely NO Japanese motifs, torii, shrines, kimono or Japanese text. No human figure, no umbrella.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE Korean Go-Stop / 맞고 hwatu CARD BACK artwork, matching a modernized classic Korean plastic hwatu deck.
INPUT IMAGE ROLE: January card provided as a STYLE AND MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY. Match the rich crimson hue, crisp screen-printed simplicity and extremely subtle glossy plastic surface, but DO NOT include any of its objects, colors as background ivory, crane, pine, sun or 光 mark.
FORMAT: portrait EXACTLY 5:8, ideally 1000 by 1600 pixels. The IMAGE IS the full rectangular card-back texture, colored edge to edge. No photographic scene, no external background, no margins outside the card, no mockup, no dimensional edges, no rounded outer corners, no cast shadow.
DESIGN: solid DEEP CRIMSON RED ground reaching every outer edge. A subtle repeating traditional KOREAN geometric window lattice (문살) pattern in a slightly darker red, with simple evenly spaced diagonal lattice and small rectilinear cloud-scroll accents. Restrained, balanced pattern across the whole surface, small scale and low contrast; it should still read mainly as deep crimson from a distance. Rotate 180 degrees and the design should look identical. A SINGLE THIN GOLD RECTANGULAR INNER BORDER inset about 4 percent from the edges; sharp square corners, delicate clean line, no other border ornaments. The crimson ground and subtle pattern continue outside the thin inner gold line to the actual canvas edges. Very subtle broad glossy plastic sheen with no obvious white glare or reflections. Flat printed graphic, no embossed depth.
NO text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, Hanja, medallions, central badge or symbols. No taegeuk / yin-yang. No swastika or 卍 pattern. Absolutely no Japanese motifs, torii, shrines, kimono or Japanese writing.
